import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import lightgbm as lgb
import math
import os
import warnings

warnings.simplefilter("ignore")


def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371
    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(np.radians, [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])
    dlat = lat2 - lat1
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    c = 2 * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))
    return R * c


# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv", nrows=500000)
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Clean train data
train = train[train["fare_amount"] >= 2.5]
train = train[train["fare_amount"] <= 500]
train = train[
    (train["pickup_latitude"].between(-90, 90))
    & (train["pickup_longitude"].between(-90, 90))
    & (train["dropoff_latitude"].between(-90, 90))
    & (train["dropoff_longitude"].between(-90, 90))
]


def engineer_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    pickup_dt = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"])
    df["year"] = pickup_dt.dt.year
    df["month"] = pickup_dt.dt.month
    df["day"] = pickup_dt.dt.day
    df["hour"] = pickup_dt.dt.hour
    df["dayofweek"] = pickup_dt.dt.dayofweek
    df["is_weekend"] = (df["dayofweek"] >= 5).astype(int)

    df["haversine_distance"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )
    df["abs_diff_lat"] = np.abs(df["dropoff_latitude"] - df["pickup_latitude"])
    df["abs_diff_lon"] = np.abs(df["dropoff_longitude"] - df["pickup_longitude"])
    df["manhattan_distance"] = df["abs_diff_lat"] + df["abs_diff_lon"]

    return df


train = engineer_features(train)
test = engineer_features(test)

feature_cols = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "haversine_distance",
    "abs_diff_lat",
    "abs_diff_lon",
    "manhattan_distance",
    "year",
    "month",
    "day",
    "hour",
    "dayofweek",
    "is_weekend",
]

# Chronological train/val split (last 5% as validation)
train = train.sort_values("pickup_datetime")
split_idx = int(len(train) * 0.95)
train_data = train.iloc[:split_idx]
val_data = train.iloc[split_idx:]

X_train, y_train = train_data[feature_cols], train_data["fare_amount"]
X_val, y_val = val_data[feature_cols], val_data["fare_amount"]
X_test = test[feature_cols]

lgb_params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, y_train)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, y_val, reference=lgb_train)

model = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=300,
    valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_val],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
val_rmse = math.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_preds))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.6f}")

test_preds = model.predict(X_test)

submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission["fare_amount"] = test_preds
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
